title:
🌿 Nature really does provide.

Today’s finds came straight from the hedgerows and garden:
🍏 Fresh apples for a homemade crumble.
🫐 Wild blackberries perfect for crumble or jam.
🌱 Cleavers (sticky weed) to make a refreshing herbal drink that’s traditionally used to support the lymphatic system.

There’s something so satisfying about turning free, seasonal ingredients into something delicious while making the most of what’s growing around us.

What’s your favourite thing to forage this time of year? 🌿🍇🍏
